title: Test results
description: What a run of the unit test answered. Written by whatever collected and judged it — a live system is outside this tool — and read back here to build the record. It answers a plan (test-plan); the two are joined by `target`.

runs.description: One entry per environment actually run, keyed by the environment's name. Held ONCE per run rather than copied onto every item: an execution date and the person who ran it are facts about the run, and copying them onto two thousand rows is how they come to disagree.

at.description: When it ran (ISO 8601). 実施日時.

by.description: 実施者, when the runner knows it. Usually filled in the delivered document instead.

collector.description: What collected and judged it, with enough version to reproduce the run.

model.description: Which model this answers — a version, a commit, a generated_at. What makes the record reproducible.

results.description: One answer per plan item attempted. An item with no answer is NOT represented here — the join against the plan is what names it, so a missing answer cannot be mistaken for a passing one.

status.description: pass/fail is the judgement; not_run says it was not attempted and must say why.

reason.description: Why it was not run. REQUIRED on not_run: an unexplained gap in a test record is the same failure as a dropped row.

actual.description: What was observed. Left out on a quiet (secret) item, where the record carries the verdict and not the value.

detail.description: Anything the judge needs to say beyond the values — which channel decided, what the product reported as the source.

at.description: When this item was answered, if it differs from its run.

unclaimed.description: Observed on the system and answering no plan item — a setting the deployed file carries that no row of the sheet claims. The reverse direction of coverage, and the one a plan cannot derive: only something that looked at the system knows it is there.

what.description: What was seen, in the vocabulary of the thing that saw it.

functional.description: Answers to the items with no row behind them (a unit's `test.functional`), keyed by the unit and the item's own text.

item.description: The item as the declaration words it.

target.description: The plan item this answers. Spelled exactly as the plan spells it — this is the join.

path.description: The category path, as the plan carries it.

evidence.description: WHERE the answer can be seen again — the same shape a row's `source` has, and for the same reason: a reference that can be resolved, never a copy of the thing itself. This tool does not store or embed evidence.

command.description: The command whose output was read, when the evidence is not a file.

allOf.description: …and so must a functional item that was not run.
